Assistant Professor (Profesor Ayudante Doctor) in the Department of Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution at Universidad Complutense de Madrid. Spatial ecologist working on quantitative biodiversity analysis, animal movement and conservation.

[Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.es/citations?user=8zRbuNgAAAAJ) · [ORCID 0000-0003-1579-9444](https://orcid.org/0000-0003-1579-9444) · [UCM research profile](https://produccioncientifica.ucm.es/investigadores/446092/detalle) · [Publications](publications.html)

**Applied contracts**: bat habitat modelling for the Spanish Bat Atlas (TRAGSA, 2024–2025); Black Stork population dynamics for the Spanish Red List assessment (Junta de Castilla y León, 2017–2018).

## Supervision

- Current: 3 researchers (research assistant, PhD candidate and co-supervised PhD student), 1 visiting student and 4 MSc theses in progress. See [People](people.html).
- Completed: 11 MSc theses (UCM Master's in Zoology and Conservation Biology; Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin) and 5 BSc theses. Member of PhD examination committees at UCM.

## Teaching

Undergraduate and graduate teaching at UCM in zoology, animal biodiversity analysis, threatened population monitoring and environmental assessment (BSc Biology; MSc Conservation Biology; MSc Zoology). Co-teacher of *Introducción a la programación en R* at the UCM Doctoral School. Coordinator of the 150-hour expert course *Aplicaciones Bioinformáticas en Biodiversidad, Ecología y Evolución*. Co-developer of the MSc course *Quantitative Conservation Biogeography* with Damaris Zurell. See [Teaching](teaching.html).

## Editorial and service

- **Editor**, *Ardeola*, the journal of the Spanish Ornithological Society (SEO/BirdLife).
- Regular reviewer for journals in ecology and conservation.
- Reviewer and contributor for [eBird](https://ebird.org/home), helping maintain data quality for one of the largest citizen science projects in the world.
- Member of the [EUFLYNET](https://www.cost.eu/actions/CA22117/) COST Action on bird migration research.

## Science communication

Speaker at **Pint of Science** (Berlin) and co-coordinator of the Potsdam edition. Workshops on bat ecology and camera trapping at **La Noche de los Investigadores** (European Researchers' Night).

![Birdwatching session during a field course](images/outreach-field.jpg){width=100% fig-alt="Students birdwatching in the field during an outreach session"}

## Field experience

Beyond current projects, fieldwork and expeditions in:

- **French Guiana**: rainforest bird communities (CEBA projects)
- **Honduras**: small mammal research with Operation Wallacea
- **Costa Rica**: mammal ecology at La Selva Biological Station
- **Spain and Morocco**: bird monitoring projects

## Open science

Code and data for our papers are available on [GitHub](https://github.com/guifandos) and archived on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org/search?q=fandos).
